title: Personal Training Packages: the club-membership grace credit against sessions lost to forfeiture at lapse
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how an active club membership preserves part of the sessions otherwise lost to forfeiture when a package lapses.

## Rule
The number of sessions lost to forfeiture at lapse equals the package's own remaining session count at the moment of lapsing, exactly as recorded on the package, less a grace credit. Where the member's own club membership is active, that membership's own personal-training discount percentage of the sessions otherwise due for forfeiture is preserved instead as a loyalty courtesy, rounded down to the nearest whole session, and only the remainder is lost to forfeiture. Where no active club membership is held, the full remaining amount is lost to forfeiture with no grace credit.

## Points of judgement
- What is held: an active club membership.
- What value it contributes: that membership's own personal-training discount percentage.
- What effect it has: that percentage of the sessions otherwise due for forfeiture is preserved as a grace credit, rounded down to the nearest whole session, rather than lost; the remainder, after subtracting the grace credit, is what is actually lost to forfeiture.
As a hypothetical illustration only, if a package's remaining session count at the moment of lapsing were 9 and the linked active membership's own personal-training discount percentage were 20, the grace credit would be 20 percent of 9 -- 1.8 sessions, rounded down to 1 session -- leaving 8 sessions actually lost to forfeiture. Where no active membership is held, all 9 of those remaining sessions would be lost to forfeiture with no grace credit.
